job: LANE F - close the IRConst aggregate gap, then complete a THIRD chain (mode::CleanMode::from_source_system)
why_this_file_exists: A gate that cannot be shown to FAIL is not a gate. Every gate this lane added was mutated, observed to fail with a message naming the specific divergence, reverted, and observed to pass again. P9 and P10 are the fail-CLOSED cases: with the emitted fixture absent or zero bytes the gate must refuse, not compare two empty CFGs and report green.
a_false_negative_this_harness_caught_in_: The first version of the CFG script substituted over the WHOLE spec file. After the module gained unit tests that quote the same block sources verbatim, two anchors (P1 and P3) stopped being unique, the substitution silently did nothing, and the MUTATED run reported PASS - i.e. the harness reported a gate as un-perturbable when in fact it had never been perturbed. Recorded rather than quietly fixed, because it is the same class of defect the gates themselves exist to catch. The helper now restricts .rs edits to lines beginning `const SRC_`, requires exactly one matching line, and aborts the run when an anchor misses.
